**APL: Athletic Propulsion Labs Women's Techloom Breeze Sneakers** - $220
This breathable, high-tech running shoe from APL has a 4.3/5 average rating from 7 reviews. Customers praise its comfort and style for both running and casual wear.

**Dublin Eskimo Boots II** - $209.99 
These waterproof and insulated winter boots have a 4.2/5 average rating from 14 reviews. They are designed for all-day comfort with features like moisture-wicking footbeds and heel/arch support.

This weatherproof leather boot from the high-end brand Aquatalia has a 4.0/5 average rating from 1 review. It features a durable rubber outsole and a sleek, stylish design.
